summary: This Wikipedia-derived note describes Nicole and Natalie, the second studio album by New York City duo Nina Sky, released July 31, 2012. It lists the three singles ("Day Dreaming", "Heartbeat" and "Comatose") and their release and video dates, and notes that the opening track "Starting Today" was recorded in 2007 for an unreleased album of the same name. It also mentions a June 9, 2012 performance at the OUT/LOUD Queer Women's Music Festival in Eugene, Oregon.
one_line: Nicole and Natalie is the 2012 second studio album by New York duo Nina Sky, with singles "Day Dreaming" and "Heartbeat".
key_facts: Nicole and Natalie is the second studio album by the New York City-based duo Nina Sky.
Nicole and Natalie was released on July 31, 2012.
Three singles were released from Nicole and Natalie: "Day Dreaming", "Heartbeat" and "Comatose".
The opening track "Starting Today" is one of the most known songs from Nicole and Natalie.
"Starting Today" was recorded in 2007 for Nina Sky's unreleased album with the same name.
On February 2, 2012, Nina Sky released "Day Dreaming" as the lead single from Nicole and Natalie.
"Day Dreaming" was produced by Beau Vallis.
The video for "Day Dreaming", directed by Adam Sauermilch, was released on February 28.
On June 14, Nina Sky released "Heartbeat", the second single from the album.
The video for "Heartbeat" was released on July 27, a month after the single.
The band said of the "Heartbeat" video: "We knew we wanted it to be more about the feeling of the song and less about the story."
On June 9, 2012, Nina Sky performed at the OUT/LOUD Queer Women's Music Festival in Eugene, Oregon.
At the OUT/LOUD Queer Women's Music Festival, Nina Sky performed alongside Krudas Cubensi, Tender Forever and Andrea Gibson.
